input_references.role: Timestamped GPS trajectory points linked by trajectory_id

metadata.goal: Summarize the trip pattern and possible changes of the user and find anomalies from the usual behavior.
metadata.category: Single-user four-week routines, weather-conditioned work routes, shopping change, health visits, and an anomalous return trip
metadata.header: MTL Trajet: 12 Single-user Routine Change and Anomaly
metadata.dataset_description: Four weeks of dense daily trajectories for one user, including route geometry, weather condition, destination land use, purpose, transport mode, and timestamped GPS points.
metadata.metric_note: `route_directness_ratio` is path length divided by straight-line endpoint distance; `returns_to_origin` indicates that the recorded end coordinates return to the start coordinates.
metadata.land_use_reference: Archived PUM2050 Affectatio polygons (2025). Labels describe reference-map zoning at fixed endpoints, not surveyed activities at the time of travel.
metadata.motion_consistency_note: Point speed is the incoming segment GPS great-circle distance divided by elapsed time; the first point repeats the first outgoing segment speed. Earth radius: 6371.0088 km. Trip distance is the sum of these segment distances. avg_speed_kmh and mean_speed_kmh are total distance / elapsed time; avg_point_speed_kmh and point_speed_mean_kmh are unweighted means of the delivered point speeds. speed_cv is the population coefficient of variation of incoming segment speeds, excluding the duplicated first endpoint. trajectory_progress is point_index / (point_count - 1), not elapsed-time fraction. Timestamps and speed fields were reconstructed for internal consistency on 2026-10-09; GPS positions and insight wording were preserved. These are curated example records, not newly recovered observations.

insight_list.insight: The user has two recurring motor-vehicle routes from the same origin to a work destination in a mapped residential area: route A is shorter and used on sunny days, while every rainy-day commute uses the longer route B detour.

plot.title: Work Route and Weather Pattern
plot.description: Recomputed from the delivered fixed GPS coordinates and the archived official PUM2050 Affectatio polygons; Unmapped denotes no containing polygon.

insight_list.question: How are the user's motor-vehicle commute route variants associated with weather conditions?
insight_list.code:
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
df = pd.read_csv(dataset_path)
points = pd.read_csv(Path(dataset_path).with_name('trajectory_points.csv'))
work=df[df.trip_role.eq('work_commute')]; print(work.groupby(['weather_condition','route_variant']).distance_km.agg(['count','mean'])); print(work.destination_land_use.value_counts())
insight_list.evidence: Trip purpose is work; the official polygon at the work endpoint is Résidentiel. Work purpose does not imply an employment land-use category.
